title: Career Roadmap: Data Scientist
summary: Use statistics, programming, machine learning and data analysis to discover patterns, build predictive models and solve business or scientific problems using data.

blocks.text: Use statistics, programming, machine learning and data analysis to discover patterns, build predictive models and solve business or scientific problems using data.

rows.text: Mathematics is strongly recommended; Physics and Computer Science are useful
BS in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, B.Sc. Data Science, B.Tech. CSE/AI or Statistics/Mathematics
Machine learning, predictive analytics, deep learning, NLP or computer vision
M.Sc./M.Tech. in Data Science, AI, Statistics or a related field, where beneficial

blocks.text: Check the specific BS programme's admission requirements and ensure the curriculum includes mathematics, statistics, programming and machine learning.

blocks.label: Programming
blocks.text: Python, NumPy, pandas and scikit-learn.

blocks.label: Mathematics
blocks.text: Linear algebra, probability, statistics and calculus fundamentals.

blocks.label: Data Management
blocks.text: SQL, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis and feature engineering.

blocks.label: Machine Learning
blocks.text: Regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation and validation.

blocks.label: Visualization
blocks.text: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI or Tableau.

blocks.label: Advanced Skills
blocks.text: Deep learning, NLP, cloud platforms and model deployment as specialization areas.
Build three to four end-to-end projects:

blocks.label: Prediction
blocks.text: Develop a model for customer churn, demand or price prediction.

blocks.label: Classification
blocks.text: Create a fraud-detection or customer-risk model.

blocks.label: Natural Language Processing
blocks.text: Build a text-classification or sentiment-analysis system.

blocks.label: End-to-End ML
blocks.text: Train, evaluate and deploy a model through an API or simple web application.
Document the problem statement, dataset, preprocessing, model selection, evaluation metrics, limitations and results.
Target opportunities at:
Apply for Data Science Intern, Machine Learning Intern, Analytics Intern and Research Intern positions based on your current skills.
Useful areas include:

items.text: Deep learning with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Cloud fundamentals on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
MLOps, model deployment and experiment tracking.

blocks.text: Prioritize projects and model evaluation skills over collecting multiple introductory certificates.
Data Science / ML Intern
Junior Data Scientist / Data Analyst
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
Senior Data Scientist → Lead / Principal Data Scientist
Data Analyst can be an entry route, while ML Engineer is a related but distinct role with stronger software and deployment requirements.

rows.text: Strengthen Python, SQL, statistics and exploratory data analysis.
Learn core ML algorithms and complete one supervised learning project.
Build and evaluate an end-to-end project, publish documentation and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong Python and SQL, sound statistical reasoning, practical machine-learning experience, appropriate model evaluation and two to four well-documented projects.
